headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: (IMFA) Result Update| Sector: Metals & Mining SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key highlights of the 2QFY27 Result Volume growth drives robust performance Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd.
(IMFA) during 2QFY27 reported 34.7%/69.8%/51.5% YoY increase in Revenue/EBITDA/PAT to Rs 968 cr/235 cr/Rs 148 cr respectively.
The company achieved its highest-ever quarterly Ferro chrome (FeCr) sales volume of 81,998 metric tonnes (MT), up 17.5% YoY led by volume contribution from the recently commissioned KNR-2 facility.
However, profitability registered a dip sequentially, with EBITDA/t reaching Rs 28,643, down from Rs 35,483 in 1QFY27, also resulting in EBITDA margin moderating to 24.3% sequentially from 29.3%.
valuation: Combined with Sukinda (0.6 mnt), the projected increase will result in a total underground chrome ore raising capacity of 1.35 mnt, exceeding the ongoing capex target of 1.2 mnt, thereby paving the way for future smelting expansions.
We value the stock at Rs 1,996, implying an upside of 77.2% from CMP of Rs 1,126, based on FY28E EV/EBITDA multiple of 9.5x.
